entries.prompt: A stylized Korean webtoon character standing in a perfect T-pose with both arms stretched straight out horizontally to the sides, wearing a white long-sleeve sailor school uniform top with a large navy sailor collar with a V opening at the chest, navy cuffs, waist-length hem, plain dark gray trousers, bare feet, bald head with a calm neutral face. Matte fabrics with simplified soft folds, clean simple shapes, each garment a clear separate piece, no logos, no text, evenly lit, plain white background.
